title: Applicable law and forum
description: The law and the forum of a process. Identifies the body of law governing the agreement, the named adjudication forum and, optionally, the proceedings language. Provider-agnostic by construction: every field is a free-form string whose pattern enforces SHAPE only — the named external standard (ISO 3166 for jurisdiction, ISO 639 / BCP 47 for language) remains the source of truth, and the clause never holds a closed list of jurisdictions, forums, or languages. Compose with `figaro-arbitration-kleros` (or another `figaro-arbitration-<provider>`) to add a decentralized ODR layer. CHOSEN BY THE BUYER AT CHECKOUT, once for every agreement of the process: the designer composes the clause at assembly scope with no values (no field is a design fill); the buyer fills it at checkout and checkout writes the one value into every order's agreement, so the law and the forum stand in every order's checkoutHash; each seller accepts them by counter-signing its order. Dispute resolution is optional to compose; once composed, the law and the forum are required — the buyer chooses them, and an agreement with either empty fails the sign gate on both sides.

fields.name: applicableLaw
fields.label: Applicable law
fields.description: Identifier for the body of law that governs the agreement. Conventionally an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. 'US', 'NL', 'JP'), optionally with an ISO 3166-2 subdivision (e.g. 'US-CA', 'CA-ON'); 'EU' for European Union law; 'INTL' for international / treaty law. Free-form for non-state legal orders (e.g. 'Sharia', 'ICANN-UDRP'). The pattern admits a hyphen-joined alphanumeric token that starts with a letter — it enforces shape only, never a fixed list of jurisdictions; the cited standard is the source of truth.

fields.name: forum
fields.label: Adjudication forum
fields.description: Named adjudication forum (e.g. 'JAMS-arbitration', 'AAA-arbitration', 'ICC-arbitration', 'us-federal-court', 'small-claims-court', or a spelled-out court such as 'Courts of England and Wales'), chosen by the buyer at checkout. Required once the clause is composed: a process with this clause names its forum.

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language of proceedings
fields.description: Language for adjudication proceedings as an ISO 639-1 two-letter code (e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'zh', 'ar') or ISO 639-2 three-letter code (e.g. 'eng'), optionally with a BCP 47 region or script subtag (e.g. 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hant'). OMIT the field to mean: official language of the forum.
